unit.question: Tolong buat dashboard performa toko: pendapatan, pesanan, Juni vs Juli.

gt.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2025-06-01' AND order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN total_amount END) AS june, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND order_date < '2025-08-01' THEN total_amount END) AS july FROM NOVA_DEMO.orders

unit.expect_insight: Compute the comparison the data allows: June 2025 vs July 2025 revenue and orders, noting July covers only 1-5 July. Stopping at a total when this comparison is possible is shallow.
unit.note: F5 page: header, KPI tiles from verified figures and at least one chart or table section; figures come from @Value, never typed.

Untuk dashboard perbandingan Juni dan Juli 2025, ambil revenue (pendapatan) dan order_count (jumlah pesanan) per bulan order_date untuk Juni dan Juli 2025, dengan filter yang sama untuk kedua metrik: status <> 'cancelled' (jangan sertakan pesanan dibatalkan). Urutkan bulan secara kronologis.

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', `orders`.`order_date`) AS `order_date`,
  SUM(`orders`.`total_amount`) AS `revenue`,
  COUNT(`orders`.`order_id`) AS `order_count`
FROM `NOVA_DEMO`.`orders` AS `orders`
WHERE `orders`.`status` != 'cancelled'
  AND `orders`.`order_date` >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00.000000'
  AND `orders`.`order_date` < '2025-08-01 00:00:00.000000'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', `orders`.`order_date`)
ORDER BY `order_date` ASC
